items.exampleEn: I left my keys somewhere in the house.
items.exampleZh: 我把鑰匙忘在家裡的某個地方了。

items.exampleEn: This is possibly the best pizza in town.
items.exampleZh: 這可能是城裡最好吃的披薩。

items.exampleEn: I am truly sorry for being late.

items.exampleZh: 房子是我們自己油漆的。
除了 Tom 以外，大家都來了。

items.exampleEn: I can't find my phone anywhere.
items.exampleZh: 我到處都找不到我的手機。

items.sentenceEn: We don't go to that restaurant anymore.
items.sentenceZh: 我們已經不去那家餐廳了。

items.audioEn: The shop is open every day except Monday.
items.audioZh: 那家店除了星期一以外，每天都有開。

items.sentenceEn: You can sit anywhere you like.

items.stemEn: I was so tired that I could ____ walk.

items.stemZh: 整頓晚餐都是我們自己煮的。

items.passageEn: Amy and her husband wanted to take a holiday, but they could hardly decide where to go. Amy wanted to go somewhere warm. Her husband said, "I don't mind. We can go anywhere except a big city." In the end, they chose a small town by the sea. "Let's plan everything ourselves," Amy said. It was truly a great holiday, possibly their best one ever.
items.passageZh: Amy 和先生想去度假，卻幾乎決定不了要去哪裡。Amy 想去溫暖的地方。她先生說：「我都可以。除了大城市，去哪裡都行。」最後他們選了一個海邊的小鎮。Amy 說：「我們自己規劃所有的事吧。」那真是一次很棒的假期，可能是他們到目前為止最棒的一次。

questions.questionZh: Amy 的先生說哪裡不想去？

options: 很普通，跟平常的假期差不多
可能是他們最棒的一次

referenceEn: I do not drink coffee anymore.
rubricZh: 用否定句加 anymore 表示「不再」（例如 don't … anymore），anymore 通常放句尾
說現在的習慣用現在式（例如 don't drink）；寫 I no longer drink coffee 意思相同，也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 except 造一個句子，說說某一類東西你都喜歡，只有一樣例外。
referenceEn: I like all vegetables except carrots.
I like all kinds of fruit except bananas.
rubricZh: except 後面接名詞，表示「除了⋯之外」（例如 except carrots）
except 前面常是表示「全部」的說法（例如 all vegetables、every kind of fruit）
句子說的是自己的喜好，主詞是 I
